verdict.rationale: Bugbot is a PR-review service, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence documents only triggers by PR comment (`cursor review`, `bugbot run`), automatic PR reviews, and IDE or web fix links, with no Bugbot command-line tool. A community user triggering reviews through their own GitHub Action is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
